title: Scattered Pamphlets
subtitle: They fall like snowflakes, bringing with it horrible news and whispers of temptation.

trails.title: Trail ① Arcanum Military Equipment List
trails.description: These multi-legged thieves sneak in, but they are still caught by the falcon's eyes.

content.text: Arcanum Military Equipment List: Individual Vehicles

An air combat broom of the Su-01ве (Witch) series for individual combat. With high mobility, high attack and wide range, this arcane vehicle can bring an aerial advantage to its pilot.
The series applies titanium alloy and a lancet-like design. As a result, its streamlines allow it to fly faster than any other models (maximum level speed: 1553 mph). Beneath the main body is a wedge-shaped air inlet which guarantees the aerodynamic performance and there is an arcanum detector in the middle of the body. The broom is also equipped with an ST-30-1 30mm Instant Arcane Skill Casting Device at the bottom which works with a high-precision laser ranging aiming system.

The Su-01ве (Witch) series was cooperatively developed by the Sukhoi Design Bureau and ■■■■. Experience of piloting arcanum vehicle is required for its operation. Besides, the pilot must possess outstanding G-tolerance as the overload brought by the excessive mobility is inevitable.
For now all the models of the Su-01ве (Witch) series belong to the Zeno Arms Academy and work as its main tactical vehicles. Only pilots who have been trained rigorously and systematically are qualified for piloting.

items.text: Scattered Pamphlets
Someone is at the door.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Madam Vice President.
Holding a chess piece of bishop in her hand, Constantine doesn't even bother to look up.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Come in.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Here is the monthly department report.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Any news I shouldn't miss?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: The mainstream media in Europe are on our side and have no extra coverage on the issue. In fact, as long as there is no tangible evidence, they won't act upon this rashly.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: The "Storm" ... hasn't come to this era yet.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: For most of the people, what Manus Vindictae has said in their pamphlets is totally unfounded and ludicrous.
Constantine gets on her feet.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: They have been making quite a scene here and there, as I heard.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Yes. Residents nearby have all received their pamphlets. Even the SPDM (School of Primary Defense of Mankind) has reported some cases.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Affected by the time reversion, our manpower and resources have become much less than before. It will take us a long time to complete the city-wide air defense system.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Were these pamphlets airdropped?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Yes, most of them were.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Give me the visual of the "ariel carriers" of Manus Vindictae.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: These are Olitiaus. Their sizes are about four to six feet, covered mostly in black.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: They have a similar appearance to manta rays and have good manoeuvrability and explosive power.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Olitiau 04. This type of Olitiau has limited operation range and cannot take a long-haul. They are too dependent on the water.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Indeed. According to our report, they usually leave after a three-hour hovering every day.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Heh-heh ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Ms. Z, where do you see fit for this bishop ...?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Hmm ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I think it should go to b5.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Yes, I thought the same.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Olitiaus are highly adequate for low-altitude aerial reconnaissance surveys. But they are only found in the southern part of Cameroon and difficult to capture. It is a very rare arcane species.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Sending these many Olitiaus on such short notice ... I would presume Manus Vindictae has already established a command post somewhere nearby.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I don't see how this is helpful. As they said themselves, the "Storm" is coming ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: What do you say if this new command post of theirs, like our headquarters ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: is a building that will not be affected by the "Storm"?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: They need to make sure that Olitiaus won't be affected by the "Storm" ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I think you know what to do, Ms. Z.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Take over the initiative, find their location.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Exactly. Send a scout squad to follow the Olitiaus and get the others to search in the water catchment areas within 100 miles from here.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We are going behind their front lines, just like this bishop ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I will forward these to the Secretary of the Army.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Make a copy to the Pax House as well.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: ... Copy that.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: What about the school's air defense?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: There have been rumors in school. I'm worried the students might be affected.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Send Zeno's air force trainees to the school.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Affirmative. Olitiaus are crafty creatures. I will pick those who are equipped with field experience.
Constantine does not respond.
She stares at the black king on the board and broods.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: *sighs* We are leading ourselves into a death trap ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We need someone to forecast the "Storm."
School of Primary Defense of Mankind
Hah ...! Finally got to let my baby Su-01ве out for a ride. It feels right!
Lazy laughter comes from above.
This is where they train those little lab rats?
Uh-huh. Five canteens ... Way better than that stupid Zeno!

items.speaker: Airforce Trainee
items.text: Oi, Lilya! We don't have the signal yet. You must NOT take off!

items.speaker: Airforce Trainee
items.text: Get down here, now!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Nobody cares, dude. There will always be a signal.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Either you move your ass ... or swallow my exhaust! Haha!
She leaves like a wind.

items.speaker: Airforce Trainee
items.text: This is outrageous. For once I forgot my rabbit's foot and I got assigned to team up with her ...
He looks at the lookout tower from a distance. Behind him, danger approaches and yet he has no idea.
Olitiaus, two of them, are charging towards him from his blind spots.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Andrew, head down!!

items.speaker: Airforce Trainee
items.text: What ...?!
As soon as Andrew lowers his head, Lilya's Su-01ве rips the Olitiaus' abdominals with a swift and clean cut.

items.speaker: Airforce Trainee
items.text: Watch where you go! You gonna slice my head off if I weren't quick enough!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Shut up and take your broom.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: See those dark "bats" there?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Let's see who come back with more trophies.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Loser loser, vodka coaster!

items.speaker: Airforce Trainee
items.text: Oi, hey ... Wait up!
TO BE CONTINUED…
